content: The detection of development errors shall be configurable ( ON / OFF ) at pre - compile time . The switch SdDevErrorDetect (see chapter 9 ) shall activate or deactivate the detection of all development errors.

The detection of development errors shall be configurable (ON / OFF) at pre-compile time. The switch SdDevErrorDetect (see chapter 9) shall activate or deactivate the detection of all development errors.
